title: Taco Stuffed Celeriac
description: A flavorful and unique twist on traditional tacos. Celeriac replaces the traditional taco shell, providing a crunchy and refreshing base for your favorite fillings.

ingredients.name: Celeriac
ingredients.notes: Peel and dice the celeriac into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: Umami-rich Mushroom Broth
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade broth

ingredients.name: Taco Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Follow the instructions on the package

ingredients.name: Tacos
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade tacos

ingredients.name: Shredded Cheese
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Cheddar work well

instructions: Toss the celeriac pieces with a tablespoon of oil and season with salt and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the celeriac is roasting, cook the Mexican Rice according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the Umami-rich Mushroom Broth over medium-high heat.
Add the Taco Seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the shredded cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and well combined.
Warm the tacos according to the package instructions.

To assemble the Taco Stuffed Celeriac, place a spoonful of the Taco Filling into the roasted celeriac 'shell'. Top with a spoonful of Mexican Rice, a sprinkle of cilantro, and your favorite taco toppings.
Let leftovers cool completely before refrigerating or freezing.
